audience: city, parks and urban forestry teams that manage tree and asset inventories in TreePlotter

useCases.title: Read the features of an inventory layer
useCases.text: List the inventory layers of the folder, then read the features of one layer with lookup values in readable text.

useCases.title: Read the fields of an asset before a change
useCases.text: Read the field metadata of an inventory layer, then read one feature by its Primary ID to see its current values.

useCases.title: Review the work orders
useCases.text: List the work orders (jobs) of the folder and open one to read its details. Read the work order fields first.

useCases.title: Review the service requests about assets
useCases.text: List the service requests of the folder, then open one by its ID to read the request.

useCases.title: Add a new asset to an inventory layer
useCases.text: Read the field names of the layer, then create the feature. Point layers need lat and lng in the data.

useCases.title: Create or update a work order
useCases.text: Read the work order field names, then create a work order or change its fields, for example its status.
